desc: The EOTECH HHS UNITY 1 pairs the battle-proven EXPS3-0 and G33 magnifier with the UNITY FAST FTC OMNI Mount and FAST Optic Riser, enabling rapid transitions from CQB to long-range engagements. With a 2.26-inch optical centerline height that improves heads-up shooting posture and situational awareness, the FTC OMNI Mount allows the magnifier to stow completely below the optic's sightline for instant, obstruction-free target acquisition.
